title: M5 stage10: replacing one support exponent after CRT
scope: Six finite-support replacement targets with verified accepted monomial-period theorem imported

metadata.obligation: Shared objects and exact root statement; definition correspondence review
Existence/computation of t(F), `F ∣ M N ↔ t(F) ∣ N` for positive N; repeated factors and F=1
Anchoring by independent translations preserves signature and connectivity
Binary additive-character orthogonality, including dimension zero
Character product coefficient equals the k-subset residue count
Signed binomial coefficient formula evaluates that coefficient without subset enumeration
Character power sum counts ordered residue tuples with repetition, including length zero
Squarefree divisors of `rad(M_N/F)` detect exact complete gcd, retaining the next multiplicity exclusion
Integer divisor Möbius indicator detects combined support gcd one
C equals the number of connected anchored weight-w pairs of exact signature F; inadmissible cases zero
Selected/available completion formula is exact for both blocks
Positive C deterministically yields a valid pair in at most `2(N-1)` position decisions
A equals the number of feasible anchored ordered residue patterns
Conditional tuple counts recover a feasible pattern in at most `2(w-1)T` candidate tests
Every connected physical source reduces to a feasible period pattern
Pack each residue's multiplicities into distinct anchored exponents at most `wT-1`, preserving reduction
A shift of one positive first-block exponent by kT makes total support gcd one, preserving weight and residues, with every exponent below `wT(T+2)`
Ordinary G has constant term one, `gcd(G,M_T)=F`, and degree at most `wT-1` because the second block is unchanged
`E=t(G) ≤ 2^deg(G)` and `T ∣ E`, including G=1
Same literal supports have exact F at all `N=T+jE` above their support cutoff; ring congruence preserves multiplicities
Positive A constructs a connected source below `B=wT(T+2)+2^(wT)` and an infinite progression
`A>0` iff any-order connected realization exists; A=0 is a global nonrealizability certificate
A realization requires `T ∣ N` and `max(w,deg(F)+1) ≤ N`
The bounded minimum of positive C values is nonempty and is the exact first birth; recover its witness
Every proposed order is classified by exact C; positive reconstructs and zero proves sector absence
All invoked evaluations are finite factorization, divisor, character, power and binomial arithmetic; reconstruction terminates without raw pair scans
At w=1 the only connected anchored source is N=1 with F=1
Assemble the full original arithmetic M5 theorem for all positive weights and complete signatures

spec.name: M5.RepairSupport.replacement_card
spec.statement: ∀ (A : Finset ℕ) (e q : ℕ), e ∈ A → q ∉ A → (M5.RepairSupport.repaired A e q).card = A.card
spec.guidance: Unfold repaired. q is absent from A.erase e because q∉A; use Finset.card_insert_of_notMem and card_erase_of_mem. The original support A is a Finset, without any assumption on a source residue tuple. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.

spec.name: M5.RepairSupport.replacement_anchor
spec.statement: ∀ (A : Finset ℕ) (e q : ℕ), e ≠ 0 → 0 ∈ A → 0 ∈ M5.RepairSupport.repaired A e q
spec.guidance: Zero survives erase e since e≠0, and is retained by insert q. No freshness or positivity assumption on q is needed for this lemma. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.

spec.name: M5.RepairSupport.replacement_range
spec.statement: ∀ (A : Finset ℕ) (e q L : ℕ), (∀ a ∈ A, a < L) → q < L → ∀ a ∈ M5.RepairSupport.repaired A e q, a < L
spec.guidance: Split membership in insert q (A.erase e). The inserted case uses q<L; surviving membership implies membership in A. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.

spec.name: M5.RepairSupport.replacement_combined_gcd
spec.statement: ∀ (A B : Finset ℕ) (e q : ℕ), M5.RepairSupport.combinedGcd (M5.RepairSupport.repaired A e q) B = Nat.gcd q (Nat.gcd ((A.erase e).gcd id) (B.gcd id))
spec.guidance: Unfold combinedGcd and repaired. Finset.gcd_insert gives gcd of q and the erased support gcd, with id q=q. Reassociate using Nat.gcd_assoc. Gcd insertion is idempotent, so this identity requires neither membership nor freshness. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.

spec.name: M5.RepairSupport.replacement_connected
spec.statement: ∀ (A B : Finset ℕ) (e q : ℕ), Nat.gcd (Nat.gcd ((A.erase e).gcd id) (B.gcd id)) q = 1 → M5.RepairSupport.combinedGcd (M5.RepairSupport.repaired A e q) B = 1
spec.guidance: Rewrite replacement_combined_gcd and use Nat.gcd_comm to match the given gcd δ q=1. This is integer support gcd1, not yet connectivity at a chosen cyclic order N. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.

spec.name: M5.RepairSupport.replacement_polynomial_residue
spec.statement: ∀ (A : Finset ℕ) (e k T : ℕ), e ∈ A → e + k * T ∉ A → AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport (M5.RepairSupport.repaired A e (e + k * T))) = AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport A)
spec.guidance: Expand the new support sum using Finset.sum_insert (freshness implies the inserted exponent is absent from A.erase e). Expand the old sum by sum_erase_add or insert_erase using e∈A. Map both finite sums and use the verified accepted stage8 quotient_monomial_period at a=e,j=k for equality of replaced monomial residues. The freshness hypothesis is essential: inserting an already present different exponent would collapse a term. Do not assume squarefreeness or exclude binary cancellation. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.
